abstract: Nexcess is managed WordPress hosting, now part of Liquid Web. Plans start at $19 a month for one site and include email, staging and migration. There are no data centers in Asia.

acceptedAnswer.text: In practice, yes. Nexcess and Liquid Web announced in February 2024 that they would become one brand, and in April 2026 the hosting arm was renamed Liquid Web by Nexcess. The managed WordPress plans are the same product on both sites.

mainEntity.name: How much does Nexcess hosting cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: On Nexcess's plan page on 20 November 2026, Pro WordPress was from $19 a month and Elite from $29, for one site with up to 50,000 visits. Annual billing takes 10% off. Prices rise with each visit tier.

mainEntity.name: What resources are included with Nexcess hosting plans?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every plan has a firewall, Object Cache Pro, an edge CDN, a staging site and a development site, free SSL, email hosting and 24/7/365 support. Pro has 20 GB for one site and 14 days of backups. Elite has 40 GB and 30 days.
Yes. Nexcess lists email hosting in the included features of every managed WordPress plan.

Yes. Its Sites and Stores pages list WooCommerce, Magento and Shopware hosting, and its managed WordPress plans run WooCommerce. Test checkout on your own data, because Webhostingcat saw a slow checkout on Liquid Web.

mainEntity.name: What are the best Nexcess plans for Magento hosting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nexcess lists Magento hosting on its Sites and Stores pages, but HostingEngines found no public prices, only a chat button. Ask Nexcess for a quote based on your catalog and traffic.

mainEntity.name: What kind of cloud hosting does Nexcess offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Its parent, Liquid Web, sells managed WordPress, VPS, cloud, dedicated and bare metal hosting. This page covers the managed WordPress plans.

mainEntity.name: Does Nexcess have a money-back guarantee?

acceptedAnswer.text: The plan page does not state one. Website Planet reported 30 days. Ask Nexcess in chat before you buy and read the terms in your cart.

mainEntity.name: Does Nexcess cost more at renewal?

acceptedAnswer.text: The plan page shows one price and no renewal figure. Real Tool Stack notes that the terms allow price increases with 30 days' notice. Read the renewal terms in your order summary.

Yes in independent tests. Webhostingcat measured a 202 ms time to first byte and a 433 ms Largest Contentful Paint, and two testers saw 0% errors at 1,000 concurrent users. First-byte times reached 1.9 seconds from India.
Yes for business sites and stores with visitors in the US, UK or Australia. It includes staging, Object Cache Pro, an edge CDN and human-assisted migration.
The plan page lists 24/7/365 support but no phone line. Website Planet reported chat connecting immediately and a ticket answered in 15 minutes.
Nexcess costs less, at $19 against $35 for one site, and includes email. Kinsta has a renewal price that stays the same and a free first month for new customers. Compare them at your own traffic.
